title: Large transform payloads are unreliable across store/load cells
wanted_capability: A reliable way to persist structured transform payloads such as generated edits/creates across isolate cells, or a first-class transform-and-apply primitive that avoids cross-cell payload transfer.
missing_primitive: reliable store/load for large transform payloads
fallback_used: Keep java.extractClass and edits.apply in the same code cell so the transform return stays in a local variable.
notes: A probe lost the changes array after storing a transform result and loading it in a later cell, forcing a full re-run of the transform. Genericized; no private file or symbol names recorded.
